primary.title: Hitachi Energy’s growth outlook powers rally. Have valuations run ahead?
primary.summary: A strong earnings performance, robust order inflows and confidence in long-term demand sent Hitachi Energy shares soaring. The company expects growth to be supported by upcoming HVDC projects and continued investments in power transmission.
